mapper.insert: INSERT INTO research_stat_publication(publication_key,record_kind,resource_accession,resource_url,title,pub_year,source_codes,source_record_keys,authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,keyword_list,raw_payload,content_hash,has_primary_source,is_active) VALUES(CONCAT(#{r.databaseCode},':RESOURCE:',#{r.accession}),'RESOURCE',#{r.accession},#{r.sourceUrl},#{r.title},#{r.releaseYear},#{r.databaseCode},#{keys},#{r.authorsJson},#{r.affiliationInfo},#{r.grantsJson},#{r.cncbBanksJson},#{r.keywordList},#{r.rawPayload},#{hash},#{r.primaryRecord},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time=CASE WHEN NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)) OR is_active=0 OR has_primary_source<VALUES(has_primary_source) THEN NOW() ELSE update_time END, has_primary_source=GREATEST(has_primary_source,VALUES(has_primary_source)),is_active=1, relation_status=CASE WHEN NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)) THEN 'PENDING' ELSE relation_status END, title=VALUES(title),resource_url=VALUES(resource_url),pub_year=VALUES(pub_year),authors_json=VALUES(authors_json),affiliation_info=VALUES(affiliation_info),grants_json=VALUES(grants_json),cncb_banks_json=VALUES(cncb_banks_json),keyword_list=VALUES(keyword_list),raw_payload=VALUES(raw_payload), content_hash=VALUES(content_hash)
mapper.select: SELECT id source_row_id,source_codes source_code,CONCAT('RESOURCE:',resource_accession) source_record_key,'RESOURCE' record_kind,resource_accession resource_accession,resource_url,is_active record_active,NULL pmid,NULL doi,title,pub_year pub_year,authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,keyword_list,NULL mesh_headings_json,has_primary_source primary_flag FROM research_stat_publication WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND source_codes=#{code} AND id>#{after} AND is_active=1 AND (has_primary_source=1 OR #{related}=TRUE) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_stat_publication WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND source_codes=#{code} AND is_active=1 AND (has_primary_source=1 OR #{related}=TRUE)
SELECT DISTINCT pub_year FROM research_stat_publication WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND source_codes=#{code} AND pub_year IS NOT NULL AND is_active=1 AND (has_primary_source=1 OR #{related}=TRUE)

SELECT id source_row_id,source_codes source_code,CONCAT('RESOURCE:',resource_accession) source_record_key,'RESOURCE' record_kind,resource_accession resource_accession,resource_url,is_active record_active,NULL pmid,NULL doi,title,pub_year pub_year,authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,keyword_list,NULL mesh_headings_json,has_primary_source primary_flag FROM research_stat_publication WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND source_codes=#{code} AND resource_accession IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE research_stat_publication SET is_active=0,update_time=NOW() WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND publication_key=CONCAT(#{code},':RESOURCE:',#{id}) AND is_active=1
mapper.select: SELECT 'SOURCE_KEY' identifier_type,CONCAT('RESOURCE:',resource_accession) identifier_value,NULL pmid,NULL bioproject_accession,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,content_hash source_hash,relation_status FROM research_stat_publication WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND publication_key=CONCAT(#{code},':RESOURCE:',#{id}) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE research_stat_publication SET relation_status=#{status},relation_last_error=#{error},update_time=NOW() WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND publication_key=CONCAT(#{code},':RESOURCE:',#{id})
UPDATE research_stat_publication SET grants_json=#{grants},update_time=NOW() WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND publication_key=CONCAT(#{code},':RESOURCE:',#{id})
mapper.select: SELECT update_time source_updated_time, id source_row_id,source_codes source_code,CONCAT('RESOURCE:',resource_accession) source_record_key,'RESOURCE' record_kind,resource_accession resource_accession,resource_url,is_active record_active,NULL pmid,NULL doi,title,pub_year pub_year,authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,keyword_list,NULL mesh_headings_json,has_primary_source primary_flag FROM research_stat_publication WHERE record_kind='RESOURCE' AND source_codes=#{code} AND (has_primary_source=1 OR #{related}=TRUE) AND update_time < #{until} AND (update_time > #{time} OR (update_time=#{time} AND id > #{after})) ORDER BY update_time,id LIMIT #{size}
